header: Numbered steps joined by a line
lead: Steps appear in the order the editor sets, joined by a line so readers see the order before they read. On small screens the line runs down the side.

steps.title: Numbers follow the order
steps.text: Move a step and the numbers update, because they are counted from the list itself.

steps.title: Two to four across
steps.text: The column count is held, so a three-step process never breaks into two columns.

steps.title: Horizontal or vertical
steps.text: The vertical style keeps the line at the side at every width. For long instructions, use the numbered steps in Content.
